confluence.title: RFC: Core Service Launch Readiness Checklist (v2.4)
confluence.author: tech-lead
confluence.content:
# Core Service Launch Criteria
1. Security: OAuth 2.0 PKCE must be 100% rolled out. Legacy session cookies deprecated.
2. Caching: Redis Cluster must be active on staging and validated under load.
3. Database: Read replicas configured and tested for failover.
4. AI Image Generation: Imagen 3 pipeline must pass content safety tests with <5s p95 latency.
5. Reliability: All CI pipelines green; no open launch-blocker tickets in Jira.
Target Launch Date: October 5, 2026.

confluence.title: Architecture RFC: Asynchronous Image Generation Pipeline (Imagen 3)
confluence.author: dave
confluence.content:
# Architecture Specification: Image Generation Flow

1. Client initiates: POST /api/v1/images/generate with prompt, aspect ratio, and negative prompt.
2. API Gateway validates auth and writes Job Record to Postgres (state: PENDING).
3. Gateway publishes event to Pub/Sub topic `image-generation-jobs`.
4. Async Imagen Worker pulls message, updates state to GENERATING.
5. Worker calls Vertex AI Imagen 3 API with prompt & safety settings.
6. On success: Worker stores PNG in GCS (`gs://generated-assets-prod/{job_id}.png`), generates Signed URL, updates DB to COMPLETED.
7. On safety block: Worker marks state FAILED_SAFETY, sends sanitized placeholder.
8. Client polls GET /api/v1/images/{job_id} or receives WebSocket completion event.

confluence.title: Runbook: Image Generation Worker Outage & Rate Limiting
confluence.author: sarah
confluence.content:
# Incident Diagnosis for Image Generation Flow

1. Alert: High Queue Lag on `image-generation-jobs` (>500 messages).
2. Step 1: Check Vertex AI Quota dashboard for 429 ResourceExhausted errors.
3. Step 2: If 429 quota reached, trigger auto-scaling worker backoff and notify Google Cloud TAM.
4. Step 3: Check GCS write error rates in Cloud Monitoring.
5. Step 4: If workers crash with OOM on image decoding, restart worker deployment with 4Gi memory limit.
